svg.text: Arduino Uno + HC-SR04 + 3 LEDs · ≤ 5 cm: red · 5-15 cm: blue blinks · > 15 cm: green · pins from v1-simple.ino · v2: same wiring as v1 (assumed; not visible in footage)
D11 = motorPin in the code: leave it empty in v1/v2 (the fan is wired in the final build)
Build it in this order — numbers match the white circles on the wires
LED long leg (+) column 12, short leg 13
Blue LED (medium) — yellowLed in the code
LED long leg (+) column 22, short leg 23
LED long leg (+) column 32, short leg 33
Why 220 Ω: it keeps each LED near (5 V − 2 V) / 220 Ω ≈ 14 mA; an Uno pin is rated 20 mA. LED long leg = + (anode), short leg goes to the − rail.
v1 and v2 differ only in code (v2: averaging filter, faster blink when closer, green "breathes"). v2's pin lines were not visible in the video, so v2 is assumed to use these pins.
Both sketches already switch D11 (motorPin) at ≤ 5 cm. The propeller fan was added in the final build: see wiring-final-fan.png. Power comes from the USB cable; top rails are not used.
